verdict.rationale: Composio docs explicitly document a webhook-based triggers system: register a webhook URL once per project, and Composio POSTs signed structured payloads for events in connected apps (Slack messages, GitHub commits, emails, etc.), enabling agents to subscribe to and react to external events. This is a first-party, well-documented feature directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery reliability and signature verification in practice.
